caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a metal candlestick holder with a handle, shown in a three-quarter view against a plain beige background. The holder has a broad, flat base that curves upward into a short circular rim, forming a shallow dish that collects any wax drippings. Rising from the center of the base is a short, turned stem leading up to a round, cup-like receptacle designed to hold a candle. Attached to the outer rim of the base and extending upward is a curved handle, allowing the object to be easily carried. The candlestick holder is rendered in shades of gray, giving it a metallic appearance, and the illustration captures the object’s contours, shadows, and highlights accurately. The artist’s name, “FRITZ BOEHMER,” appears printed in uppercase letters below the object, and additional small text is visible in the lower right corner. The overall composition is centered and isolated, providing a clear view of the candlestick holder without other objects or background distractions.
title: Lamp
